IPMotion test report

Last updated: 2026-10-03 22:29:59 (this page reloads itself every minute) · AI model used for every run: gemini-3.5-flash

How to read this page
  • Each test gives the computer a short description (a "spec") of a few blocks and one story, and asks it to make an animation.
  • Left: the REFERENCE, the real architecture diagram. It is the only truth. The yellow boxes show the few blocks this test draws (the test is a small piece of the whole chip, so the animation will not show everything).
  • Right: what the computer drew. Compare the two: are the same blocks there, with the same names, in the same regions, with arrows going the same way?
  • The Full diagram test (at the top) is the real goal: the whole reference diagram, redrawn by code, with a short story played on it. Everything below it is the older test with the AI writing the code.
  • Two pipelines are compared. v2 is the old way; v3 is the new way with automatic checks. Each is run several times, because the AI gives a different answer each time.
  • Two automatic checks: the layout check (text overlapping, things cut off, things too small) and the spec check (right names, right blocks, right arrows, right step titles).
Where things stand: the new pipeline (v3) has not been run yet with the newest checks. The AI service has a daily limit that is used up. It will run when the limit resets, and this page will fill in.
